description: Build ONE UNSIGNED transaction that puts XNT (and the token, if the wallet holds some) into the token/XNT pool on XDEX: it uses the token first, swaps the exact rest of the XNT, and deposits both sides. Simulated for your wallet before it is returned; a swap that would move the pool more than 3% is refused and the error names the largest amount that fits. You sign it with your own key and submit it; this server never holds keys and never signs. It earns a share of trading fees; it does not change faucet claims.

apexAmount.description: Optional: at most this much of the token from the wallet (default: what it holds). 0 means XNT only.

wallet.description: Your X1 wallet public key. Fee payer and signer.

xntAmount.description: XNT to use. Part of it may be swapped into the token.

name: lp_add_build
